query: UPDATE import_run SET last_contact_at = now(), last_progress_at = CASE WHEN $3 THEN now() ELSE last_progress_at END, reported_stage = CASE WHEN $3 THEN NULL ELSE reported_stage END, reason_code = CASE WHEN $3 THEN NULL ELSE reason_code END, reason = CASE WHEN $3 THEN NULL ELSE reason END WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = $2
